4.  25-56890  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Schmidt, seconded by Commissioner
  Chinchilla, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] dissolve the
  Finding Resources for Seniors Ad Hoc Committee; [2] update membership for
  the Safe House Ad Hoc Committee to now consist of Commissioner Hines,
  Commissioner Salcedo, and Commissioner Schmidt;; [3] create the 2026
  Visibility Plan Ad Hoc Committee consisting of Commissioner Chinchilla,
  Commissioner Salcedo, and Commissioner Schmidt; and [4] create the Fares
  for Seniors on Long Beach Transit Ad Hoc Committee consisting of
  Commissioner Clarke, Commissioner Hines, and Commissioner Schmidt.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  8 Chinchilla, Clarke, Salcedo, Hines, Schmidt, Sutherland, Gibbons,
  Valencia
